```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = '/fh/fast/sun_w/yub/tcr/tracerx/tcr-seq')
library(dplyr)
library(ggpubr)
```

## Output size based on I8 spacer

```{r Output size based on I8 spacer}
i8_files = list.files('decombinator_results_I8/', pattern = 'tsv$')
i8_sizes = sapply(file.path('decombinator_results_I8', i8_files), file.size)
fsize_i8 = tibble(file = i8_files, size = i8_sizes)
fsize_i8
```

## Output size based on M13 spacer

```{r Output size based on M13 spacer}
m13_files = list.files('decombinator_results_M13/', pattern = 'tsv$')
m13_sizes = sapply(file.path('decombinator_results_M13', m13_files), file.size)
fsize_m13 = tibble(file = m13_files, size = m13_sizes)
fsize_m13
```

## Compare to determine which spacer to use

```{r Compare to determine which spacer to use}
fsize = fsize_i8 |>
  full_join(fsize_m13, by = 'file', suffix = c('_i8', '_m13')) |>
  mutate(
    size_i8 = ifelse(is.na(size_i8), 0, size_i8),
    size_m13 = ifelse(is.na(size_m13), 0, size_m13)
  )
ggplot(fsize, aes(size_i8, size_m13)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = 'red') +
  theme_pubr()
```

```{r}
# Ambiguous spacer
fsize |>
  filter(size_i8 > 0, size_m13 > 0) %>%
  filter((size_i8 / size_m13 < 10) & (size_m13 / size_i8 < 10))
ambg_files = c('dcr_SRR9160586_alpha.tsv', 'dcr_SRR9160548_alpha.tsv')
```

```{r}
# Determine spacer
spacer = fsize |>
  filter(!(file %in% ambg_files)) %>%
  mutate(spacer = ifelse(size_i8 > size_m13, 'i8', 'm13')) |>
  mutate(size = ifelse(spacer == 'i8', size_i8, size_m13)) |>
  mutate(spacer = factor(spacer))
summary(spacer)
```

## Save

```{r}
saveRDS(spacer, file = 'spacer.rds')
sessionInfo()
```
